name: 53110 · Cudahy, WI
findings: ZIP 53110 (Cudahy) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53110 (Cudahy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53110 (Cudahy) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
